ctx.x: So then that one folded some way, and I went over to play up at some joint that Tatum used to play. That's where I met Art. And things progressed, and I'd take jobs and worked here and there, around town. And I was becoming pretty well-known, you know... "That new guy that's in town, that guy with the rosy cheeks, he plays pretty good." So this and that, and I was workin'...
